verdict.rationale: Orb's docs show subscriptions can be created through a subscription creation API endpoint and edited via the API (add-ons, seat quantities, discounts, minimums/maximums, scheduled effective dates), and a published OpenAPI spec covers the API. Nothing in the pack shows pausing or cancelling a subscription through the API, so only half the lifecycle is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented API pause, documented API cancel, explicit API coverage of plan changes, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, pause, and cancel subscriptions through a documented API — the full lifecycle without touching a dashboard

citations.quote: You can create a subscription either from the Orb UI or via the subscription creation API endpoint.
Subscription Edits let you change a single subscription's pricing configuration directly from Orb's web interface or via the API
Orb publishes its full OpenAPI 3.1 document on the docs domain
